The Aswang is one of the most feared creatures in Filipino folklore. By day, it looks like an ordinary person, blending into villages unnoticed. But at night, it transforms into a terrifying predator that hunts humans, especially pregnant women and young children. Legends say the Aswang can separate its upper body from its lower half, sprout bat-like wings, and use a long, hollow tongue to feed on its victims from rooftops. For centuries, stories of the Aswang have been passed down across the Philippines, making it one of the world’s most infamous cryptids and supernatural beings. #folklore #filipino #aswang #fyp #viral

(2015) The viral "Guy Disappearing" meme featured internet personality Nileseyy Niles. • The meme originated from a comedy video titled "When you not tryna get jumped • ". • In the clip, Nileseyy suddenly appears to vanish mid-run using a simple editing effect, creating the illusion that he instantly escaped danger. • The low-budget visual effect and exaggerated situation became part of what made the video so funny online. • The meme spread heavily across Vine, Twitter, YouTube, and later TikTok as a reaction format for avoiding awkward or dangerous situations. • Fans often used the clip to joke about "disappearing" whenever problems, responsibilities, or drama appeared. • The video became one of the recognizable short-form internet memes from the mid-2010s era of viral comedy content.

Sharing factual information about someone you both know, and it’s obvious they would’ve shared it if they were there — that doesn’t strike me as gossip. That’s just friends caring about one another.  But talking about about person in a mean-spirited way that you know they wouldn’t want to hear if they were there — that’s gossip. Kesakitan ini mencetuskan tindak balas agresif yang serta-merta dan semula jadi pada kucing betina. ✅ Perubahan Hormon: Selepas mengawan, kucing betina mengalami lonjakan hormon yang mencetuskan ovulasi dan juga boleh menyebabkan perubahan mood secara tiba-tiba, yang membawa kepada tingkah laku agresif atau gelisah. ✅ Keperluan Ruang: Selepas mengawan, kucing betina mungkin ingin menjauhkan diri daripada kucing jantan kerana dia tidak lagi reseptif, dan tubuhnya bersedia untuk kemungkinan kehamilan. Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

d: Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

NOT FOR THE WEAK!! 🌶️🔥 ✨ AYAM WOKU — Spicy Manadonese Chicken Stew 🇮🇩 It’s bold, fragrant, and full of flavor — this iconic North Sulawesi dish brings the heat in the best way possible 🔥🌿 Here’s the Recipe ⬇️  STEP 1: MARINADE CHICKEN 750g Chicken Juice of 1/2 Lime (Jeruk Nipis) 1/2tsp Salt In a bowl, mix chicken, lime and salt together. Let it marinate.  STEP 2: MAKE SPICE PASTE 7 Garlic cloves (16g) 10 Red Curly Chilis / Cabe Keriting (70g) 7 Birds Eye Chilis / Cabe Rawit (22g) 3 Candlenuts A thumb and a half of Ginger (30g) About 80ml of Water Throw all the spices in a blender with water, then blend til it becomes a smooth paste.  STEP 3: COOK CHICKEN 3tbsp Veg Oil 10 Shallots, Sliced (70g) Spice Paste 5 kaffir lime leaves (daun jeruk) 2 stalks lemongrass (smashed) 2 pandan leaves 1 turmeric leaf (if you can find it!) 2 scallions (sliced) 1tsp Turmeric Powder Marinated Chicken (rinse the marinade off with water, then dry the chicken before use) 500ml Water 1tsp Salt 2tsp Mushroom Stock Powder 1 tomato, sliced Kemangi a handful Before cooking, first, rinse your marinated chicken with water then dry.  Then in a big pot, sauté sliced shallots in veg oil til wilted. Then add in the spice paste, lime leaves, lemongrass stalk, pandan leaves, turmeric leaves, chopped scallions and turmeric powder. Once everything is nice and fragrant and the spice paste has deepened in color, throw in the chicken.  Give everything a mix, then add in the water, salt and stock powder. Mix again, then cover with a lid. Let it simmer gently for 30min, then add in the tomatoes and lemon basil. Let it cook for a few minutes, then serve immediately! d: Replying to @drawwithkuma Indonesian Nasi Goreng | Is It Better Than Jollof Rice: Episode 4 One of my all time favourite rice dishes. I already knew before making this that this dish could be as good as my jollof rice but is it better? 👀 Ingredients 400-500g chicken (breast or thigh) 1.5 tsp salt 1.5 tsp pepper 2 shallots (or 1 escallion shallot) 4 cloves garlic 4 chillies 2 spring onions 3 eggs (one to top the rice) 1 tbsp sambal (Indonesian chilli sauce) 1 tsp shrimp paste 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 2 tbsp soy sauce 700-800g day-old basmati rice Cucumber Tomato Recipe 1. Dice up the chicken and season with salt and pepper 2. Prepare your vegetables by dicing the shallot, thinly slicing the spring onion and crushing together the garlic and chillies (in a mortar & pestle or simply chop) 3. Heat up a pan and add some oil 4. Once heated, add the chicken and let cook for a few minutes until brown then remove 5. In the same pan, add the shallot and garlic/chilli mixture and cook until fragrant 6. Reintroduce the chicken and move everything to one side 7. Whisk up the egg and add this to the pan and combine well 8. Introduce day-old rice into the pan and stir 9. Add in some sambal/chilli sauce and shrimp paste and mix in with the rice 10. Then add the kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) and soy sauce and mix 11. Optionally, season with salt and pepper to taste 12. Add in the spring onion and combine well with the rice 13. In a separate pan, heat some oil and cook a fried egg 14. Serve with sliced cucumber and tomato on the side, top with the egg and enjoy! #nasigoreng #indonesianfood #indonesianrice #friedrice #rice

Ayam Penyet is an Indonesian dish made of fried chicken that’s been gently smashed to make it extra tender. The chicken is usually marinated with garlic, turmeric, and spices, then deep-fried until crispy.  Recipe I used: 4 chicken legs or thighs (bone-in for best flavour) 4 cloves garlic 4 shallots 3 candlenuts (or substitute 6–8 cashews) 2 cm galangal 1 tsp ground coriander ½ tsp turmeric powder 1 tsp salt 1 tsp sugar 120 ml water (½ cup) - Blend the garlic, shallots, candlenuts, galangal, coriander, turmeric, salt, sugar, and water into a smooth paste. - ⁠Pour the paste into a wok with 2 tbsp of oil, place chicken into the paste, then fry on medium high heat for 5 minutes. Flipping every minute. Now add in enough water to cover the chicken and simmer for 35-40 minutes, flipping halfway. - ⁠remove the cooked chicken and strain the liquid - ⁠boil it till the volume reduces by half then season to taste with salt Batter: 150 ml of the leftover chicken cooking liquid 80 g rice flour 20 g corn flour ½ tsp baking powder - whisk all the ingredients together, then dip the chicken into this wet batter, coating it well - ⁠deep fry at 180°C or 360°F till golden brown, remember that the chicken is already cooked so you're just crisping up the crust - ⁠serve with rice and sambal/chilli paste Sambal recipe: 6–8 red chilies 5 bird’s eye chilies 3 garlic 3 shallots 1 tomato 1 tsp toasted belacan/shrimp paste 1 tsp sugar Salt + lime juice - dry fry all the ingredients except the sugar salt and lime  - ⁠pound the ingredients together into a rough paste then season with sugar salt and lime juice #ayampenyet #indonesianfood #friedchicken #chickenrecipe #friedchickenrecipe

d: Resep Ayam Goreng Padang (untuk 8 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 2 ekor ayam pejantan utuh 1 buah jeruk nipis bumbu halus Bahan bumbu halus: 6 siung bawang putih 2 sdt ketumbar 4 cm jahe, iris 4 cm kunyit, iris 8 cm lengkuas, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk, buang batang 2 sdt garam 2 sdt kaldu ayam bubuk ¼ sdt merica 1 sdt penyedap 75 gr kelapa parut 4 sdm tepung beras 2 butir telur Bahan sambal cabe ijo: 100 ml minyak 15 siung bawang merah 160 gr cabai hijau, potong 2 buah tomat hijau, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk 1 sdt garam 1 sdt penyedap Pelengkap: nasi putih timun, kupas jeruk nipis Cara membuat: 1. Untuk bumbu halus, siapkan blender dan masukkan bawang putih, ketumbar, jahe, kunyit, lengkuas, daun jeruk, garam, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, penyedap, kelapa parut, tepung beras dan telur, lalu haluskan 2. Potong ayam menjadi empat bagian dan buang kulitnya. Marinasi ayam dengan perasan jeruk nipis dan bumbu halus, aduk merata. Diamkan minimal 1 jam di suhu ruang atau semalaman di kulkas 3. Goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi di minyak panas dengan api sedang hingga matang kecokelatan, angkat dan tiriskan 4. Untuk tambahan serundeng, goreng sisa bumbu marinasi hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan 5. Untuk sambal cabe ijo, panaskan minyak sisa menggoreng ayam, lalu masukkan bawang merah dan cabai hijau yang sudah dipotong, tumis hingga layu. Siapkan food chopper dan masukkan tumisan bawang merah dan cabai hijau, lalu haluskan sesaat 6. Tumis tomat hijau dengan minyak sisa tumisan bawang dan cabai. Tambahkan daun jeruk dan bahan sambal yang sudah dihaluskan, tumis sesaat. Tambahkan garam dan penyedap, aduk rata 7. Ayam Goreng Padang siap disajikan

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

d: ใครกำลังคิดถึงรสชาติอาหารไทยแท้ๆ สไตล์ Comfort Food ที่กินแล้วฮีลใจ เหมือนได้กลับบ้าน ต้องมาเช็กอินที่ Bangkok Soul เมือง Alhambra, CA ร้านนี้เด่นเรื่องสตรีทฟู้ดจานโปรด รสชาติเข้มข้นถึงเครื่องสุดๆ  ⭐️เมนูอาหารหลักและของทานเล่น 1. ปลากระพงทอดกระเทียม: เสิร์ฟพร้อมน้ำจิ้มซีฟู้ดรสเด็ด 2. ลาบหมูสับ: รสชาติแซ่บกำลังดี เสิร์ฟคู่ผักสด 3. หมูกรอบผัดพริกขิง + ไข่ดาว: ผัดพริกขิงรสเข้มข้นใส่ถั่วฝักยาวและพริกชี้ฟ้า 4. กุ้งโดนัท: ทอดกรอบชิ้นใหญ่ รูปร่างเหมือนโดนัท เสิร์ฟพร้อมน้ำจิ้มบ๊วย 5. ข้าวขาหมู: ขาหมูเนื้อนุ่มเปื่อย เสิร์ฟพร้อมไข่ต้มและผักกาดยื่น 6. กุ้งทอดราดซอสมะขาม: กุ้งทอดตัวโตทอดกรอบ ราดซอสมะขามรสหวานเค็มกำลังดี 7. ไก่วิงส์แซ่บ: ไก่ทอดคลุกผงแซ่บรสจัดจ้าน 8. ข้าวมันไก่ผสม (ไก่ต้ม + ไก่ทอด): เสิร์ฟพร้อมน้ำจิ้มสไตล์ไหหลำและน้ำจิ้มไก่ทอด 9. ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำหมูกรอบ: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำเส้นใหญ่น้ำข้น ใส่หมูกรอบและแผ่นเกี๊ยวทอด 🍨 ของหวานและเครื่องดื่ม  ข้าวมะม่วง: ข้าวเหนียวมูนราดกะทิฉ่ำๆ เสิร์ฟคู่กับมะม่วงสุก  ไอศกรีมกะทิ: ไอศกรีมกะทิสดทรงเครื่อง  น้ำมะพร้าวสด: เสิร์ฟมาเป็นลูกมะพร้าวพร้อมหลอดดูด 📍 พิกัด: 707 E Main St, Alhambra, CA 91801 ⏰ เวลาเปิด-ปิด: เปิดทุกวัน 2 ช่วงเวลา (11:00 น. – 15:00 น. และ 16:00 น. – 21:00 น.) #BangkokSoul #ThaiFoodCA #AlhambraEats #ข้าวมันไก่ #ร้านอาหารไทยในอเมริกา @Bangkok soul Alhambra

d: How to Make Joël Robuchon’s Mashed Potatoes ⭐️⭐️⭐️ FULL RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Ingredients: 1.25kg ratte potato (or Yukon gold) (your yield should be 1kg after peeling) 250mL whole milk 250g unsalted butter, diced  4-5 sprigs thyme 1 tsp black peppercorns 2 cloves garlic, gently smashed Fine sea salt, to taste INSTRUCTIONS: 1. In a large, heavy bottom pot, ideally large enough to fit all your potatoes in a single layer, cover your potatoes with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower your heat to medium. Allow your potatoes to cook for 20-30 minutes, or until you can pierce your potatoes with a pairing knife with zero resistance.  2. While your potatoes are cooking, bring your milk to a boil with your thyme, garlic and black peppercorns. As soon as it comes to a boil, turn off the heat and allow the aromatics to steep while the milk stays hot. 3. When your potatoes are done cooking, strain them, and let them sit in the strainer for 5-10 minutes to allow steam to be released. Once they are cool enough to touch, but still hot, peel the potatoes & discard the skins. 4. Press your potatoes through a potato ricer into a large bowl. Strain the aromatics out of your milk, and pour half of the milk into the riced potatoes. Fold the milk gently into the potatoes until incorporated. Then, pass your potatoes once more through a fine mesh strainer into a large pot (this step is optional, but does result in THE smoothest potatoes). 5. Put the pot over low heat, and add more milk as needed until your potatoes are smooth. At this point, you can decide how smooth/luxurious you would like your potatoes. If you want them to be more of a "purée", add all of the butter and remaining milk for the true Joel Robuchon Ratio. If you want more of a traditional mashed potato consistency, add less milk, and half the butter. Regardless of what you choose, at this point you can season your potatoes with salt to taste. Serve your potatoes as a side with any roast or braised meat, and enjoy!  #mashedpotatoes #michelin #potato #homecooking #recipe

Chinese Lap Cheong Carbonara Recipe Ingredient - Chinese Knife Cut Noodles - Lap Cheong  - 3 Egg Yolks - Parmesan Cheese - Freshly Grated Garlic - Scallions - Oyster Sauce - Chili Crisp - Black Pepper 1. Cut the Lap Cheong into small pieces chunks  2. In a cold pan, add in the Lap Cheong sausage, and keep heat between medium and medium low to render the fat, while mixing occasionally so all sides get crisp 3. Once the oil is rendered, set it aside to let it cool  4. In a mixing bowl, combine egg yolks, parmesan cheese, grated garlic, crushed black pepper, chili crisp, and oyster sauce. 5. Add back in the cooled down Lap Cheong and rendered fat 6. Boil the knife-cut noodles, and save some of the noodle water to add to your sauce 7. Place the mixing boil over a pot of boiling water to create a double boiler, using the steam to heat up the sauce  8. Whisk sauce constantly until it is thick and glossy  9. Fold in the noodles, mix, and top with fresh scallions  #carbonararecipe #carbonaranoodles #lapcheong #asianfusion #carbonarapasta

🇵🇭 Ilocos Empanada | Filipino Food Bible Episode 4 A crispy pocket of goodness filled with sausage, egg and papaya originating from Ilocos in the northern region of the Philippines. Many variations exist but this is my take inspired by both the Vigan and Batac versions! note: adjust ratios of water/flour depending on flour brand since absorption rates may vary. Measurements are weighed but adjust to your preference! INGREDIENTS: Vigan Longganisa/sausage: - 1kg ground pork - 170g of garlic, minced - 80 ml spiced cane vinegar - 80 ml soy sauce - 2-3 tsp of ground black pepper - 1 tbsp of brown sugar - Salt to taste - pinch of MSG Spiced Vinegar: - 15-20 cloves garlic - 3 green chili - 9 birds eye chili - 15 shallots - 700 ml cane vinegar - 1 tbsp freshly cracked black pepper - 1 tsp salt - 30 ml fish sauce Dough (Yield 7-8 ~110g per ball): - 340g rice flour - 2 cups water - pinch of salt - 1 1/2 tbsp of chicken powder - 2 1/2 tbsp of annatto powder - 4 tbsp oil  Filling: - 2:1 ratio shredded green papaya to mung beans - salt/pepper to taste INSTRUCTIONS:  - for spiced vinegar blend together all ingredients under "spiced vinegar”. set aside - For the sausage, combine all ingredients listed under "Vigan longganisa” mix and let sir for 1hr - overnight  . Sear until rendered and crispy. - soak beans for about 1-2 hrs. Drain and boil for ~15mins until soft. - Shred papaya, add salt. squeeze water out. Combine w/ munggo and season w salt and pepper. - For the dough combine annatto powder, oil, salt, chicken powder and water. Boil and add to flour. knead until the texture resembles clay. you can combine w/ flour directly on stovetop. - roll ball of dough between cut plastic until thin - In the center place your papaya mixture and form a small hollow circle. add sausage, and egg at the center - Fold, tuck in the sides, and cut excess dough using a plate. Fry at 165C until crispy - Serve w/ spiced vinegar and enjoy! #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr

🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Pork Binagoongan | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 11 One of the more underrated but S tier Filipino dishes!! Usually made with pork simmered in “bagoong alamang”, or fermented shrimp paste - best served with rice, sometimes with eggplant or green mango on the side. Its savory, funky, and slightly sweet, with tons of umami 💡Pro tip: adjust depending on your bagoong. Not all bagoong tastes the same — some are saltier, milder, or sweeter — so taste as you go and balance it out with sugar, vinegar, and tomatoes. INGREDIENTS: Binagoongan: - 1.5 kg pork ribs, blanched (you can use pork belly or cut of choice) - 5-6 tbsp bagoong guisado - 1 large onion, diced - 15-20 cloves garlic, sliced - 4 long green chilies, sliced - 350g tomatoes, sliced - 1/3 cup cane vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar - 1/4 cup soy sauce - Water as needed - Black pepper, to taste Bagoong Guisado: - 400g shrimp paste (alamang) - 25-30 cloves garlic - 7-10 red chilies - 6-7 shallots - 400g tomatoes, diced - 1/4 cup vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar Ensaladang Mangga: - Green mango - Red onion - Cilantro - Tomato - Lime - Salt - Pepper INSTRUCTIONS:  - Blanch pork for 10 minutes, before straining and rinsing. Set aside. - To make the bagoong start by blitzing onions or shallots, garlic, and red chilies in a processor.  Add to cold pan with oil and cook until garlic is slightly oasted add tomatoes, alamang, sugar and vinegar. Allow this to simmer until the oil comes out and the tomatoes are jammy. - For the binagoongan start by sauteing onions, garlic, and chilies. add back your meat and all other ingredients listed under  “Binagoongan” and simmer for 40mins-1hr or until tender - In the meantime you can pair this with a fresh ensalada by combining all ingredients under “ensalada”. - Serve and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 La Paz Batchoy | Soups So Good It Can Cure Any Sickness Ep. 31 My take on one of the Philippines most beloved noodle soups. Originating from the La Paz  district of Iloilo CIty it grew from a humble market meal into one of Iloilo’s most recognizable dishes! It’s rich, garlicky and delicious and probably one of my favorite noodle soups of all time *most ingredients are estimates since I cook and season mostly by feel so taste and season as you cook to fit your taste! :) INGREDIENTS: Kaldo / Broth: - 2 kg pork bones - 2 kg beef marrow bones - 1kg pork shoulder, kasim, or pork belly - 2 onions, roughly chopped - 4 heads garlic, halved - 2 green onion, roughly chopped - 1 tbsp peppercorns - water as needed - 1/4 cup ginamos or to taste - Salt/patis, to taste - 2-3 tsp sugar, optional Meat Toppings: - pork liver, sliced - Cooked pork shoulder, sliced Noodles & Toppings: - miki/egg noodles - crushed chicharon -  toasted garlic - spring onions - Egg yolk - Roasted Bone marrow INSTRUCTIONS: - add your pork bones and beef marrow bones to a large pot and blanch for 10 minutes. Discard water and rinse the bones before adding them back into the pot with the onions, garlic, leek, and peppercorns. Fill w/ water and simmer for 8 hours, or overnight for the best results. - Once the stock is ready, remove bones, add guinamos to a strainer lined optionally with cheese cloth and strain soup for a silkier texture. add soup back to pot -  add your pork shoulder and simmer for around 45 minutes - In a separate pot, sauté some garlic until lightly toasted before adding your broth. Season with more guinamos if needed, sugar, and fish sauce to taste. Optionally you can blend this broth along with bone marrow if you want an extra rich soup. - Add the pork liver to the reserved broth and gently simmer until fully cooked through. Avoid overcooking it so the liver stays tender. Remove and slice let it rest before slicing thinly along with pork shoulder. - Slice cooked pork and liver. - Serve with noodles, hot broth, sliced pork/ and liver, crispy garlic, spring onions scallions, crushed chicharon, an egg yolk, and ea piece of bone marrow. Enjoy! #Soups #Soup #asmr #asmrcooking

Easy Pork Salpicao Recipe | Pinoy Style Ingredients: 	•	1 kg pork kasim (cut into strips) 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	¼ cup oyster sauce 	•	1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	•	½ tsp ground black pepper 	•	1 tsp smoked paprika 	•	Minced garlic (about 1 bulb or more) 	•	Garlic powder (optional) 	•	¼ cup butter 	•	2 bulbs garlic (for frying) 	•	2 cans whole mushrooms (halved) 	•	Coconut oil (for frying) 	•	Water as needed ⸻ Instructions: 	1.	Marinate: Combine pork, soy sauce, oyster sauce, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, smoked paprika, minced garlic, and garlic powder (optional). Marinate for at least 30 minutes or longer for better flavor. 	2.	Fry the Garlic: In a pan, heat oil and fry 2 bulbs of minced garlic until golden brown. Remove and set aside for topping. 	3.	Cook the Pork: In the same pan, add a bit of coconut oil and ¼ cup butter. Sauté the marinated pork until browned. Add a bit of water and simmer until tender. 	4.	Add Mushrooms: Stir in the halved mushrooms and the fried garlic. Simmer until the sauce reduces and oil starts to render. 	5.	Serve: Top with more fried garlic and serve hot with steamed rice #pork #recipe #salpicao #yummy #foodie

Beef Mechado na Kargado Ingredients: -1 kg beef kalitiran (oyster blade), cubed -500g beef tendon -100g beef fat -3 pcs bell pepper, fire roasted, chopped -8 pcs ripe tomatoes, fire roasted, quartered -1 head garlic, minced -2 red onions, chopped -1 large carrot, cubed -1 large potato, cubed -2 tbsp tomato paste -1 beef broth cube -2 pcs dried bay leaves -1/4 cup calamansi juice -1/4 cup  soy sauce -1 pc chorizo bilbao -100g sweet pickle relish -100g processed cheese -salt and pepper, to taste -sugar -lihim na paraan, a.k.a. msg/vetsin (optional) -1 liter water, more if necessary Procedure: A.) Roast Bell Pepper/Tomato -Place bell peppers on grilling rack over a stove and roast until exterior is charred all over. Set aside, covered, for at least 10 minutes. -Do the same with the tomatoes. -Peel charred skin of bell peppers and tomatoes. Chop bell peppers and slice tomatoes into quarters. B.) Cooking Meat -Preheat a large pan, add oil and preheat. Pan fry meat cuts by batches until browned on at least 2 sides. Set aside. -On the same pan, saute garlic until lightly browned, saute onion until transluscent, add fire roasted bell peppers and tomatoes, continue cooking until tomatoes have browned and caramelized. -Add back beef cuts and cook for a couple of minutes. Add chorizo bilbao. Add tomato paste, pickle relish, calamansi juice, and soy sauce. Add bay leaves and  beef broth cube. Season with salt,  pepper, and lihim na paraan (optional). Add about a teaspoon or two of sugar to balance flavors.  -Continue to mix and cook everything for about 5 minutes to give the tomato paste a chance to cook properly. -Add sufficient water to almost submerge meat. Make sure to scrape bottom of the pan to release the browned, flavorful bits (a.k.a. "fond). Bring liquid to a boil, after which, set flame to lowest setting to initiate the simmering process. Cover pan and cook until the kalitiran/oyster blade is tender (about 1.5 to 2 hours).   -Once kalitiran is tender, set it aside. Continue to simmer the tendon, about 1 hour more or until tender. d: My Wife Has Been Begging Me To Make This… Loaded Potato Soup 4 large Russet potatoes cleaned 4 tbsps butter 2 tbsps garlic 1/2 chopped yellow onion 1/2 cup Flour 3 cups Milk 4 cups chicken stock (divided in half) Salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste 1/2 cup sour cream 16 oz velvetta cubbed 3-6 crumbled strips of bacon Optional*** Garnish with bacon and green onion Poke holes in the potatoes with a fork, microwave them for 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Halve the potatoes and cut into chunks to cool In a large pot, melt butter over medium-low heat.  Add garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent Slowly whisk the flour into the pan and stir til slightly browned.  Slowly whisk in the milk 1 cup at a time. Then add the 1/2 chicken stock. Bring to a light simmer and whisk in the salt, garlic powder and pepper. Let come to a light simmer and thicken stirring occasionally  Add velvetta, bacon and the sour cream and stir til smooth Turn off heat, and fold in potatoes  I garnish with green onion and a little bacon and my wife LOVES IT, good luck!  Ps: I use half the chicken stock when I cook the soup and when I put it away for leftovers I add the additional 2cups to thin it out…. Personal preference, you’ll see #holmescooking #potatosoup #mealideas #cookingvideo #recipe

Hot honey chicken sliders 🍔✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/3 cups buttermilk  - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp cayenne powder (use less if desired) - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard powder  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  - Slider buns Hot honey sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup hot sauce  - 1/2 cup honey - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Brush over buns. • • • #hothoneychicken #friedchicken #DinnerIdeas #Recipe #hothoney #cooking

d: Soup No.5  🇵🇭🇨🇳 | Soups So Good It Can Cure Any Sickness Ep. 28 A traditional soup made from ox 🍆 that was brought over by combining the culinary philosophy of the Chinese to include all parts of the cow along with the Filipinos who used local ingredients to flavor it.  Often touted as an aphrodisiac, but more so a delicious delicacy enjoyed by locals as “pulutan” (something to eat while drinking) or as a rainy day soup.    INGREDIENTS:  Boiling liquid: - 1 whole bat and balls - 1 thumb of ginger, sliced - ⅓ cup of vinegar - Water as needed  broth: - 5-6 bay leaves - Water as needed  - 1 red onion, chopped - 1 bulb garlic, halved - 1 thumb of ginger, sliced - 2 stalks of onion leeks - 2-3 bayleaves - 1 tbsp of salt Soup #5: - 3-4 tbsp of annatto oil - 1 red onion, diced - 15-20 cloves of garlic, sliced - 1 stalk of onions leek, sliced - 1 thumb of ginger, juiliened - 3 lgreen chilies - 4 birds eye chilies - ⅓ packet sibot - 1/4 cup brown sugar - Salt & pepper to taste - 1 radish, sliced - 1 stalk lemongrass, tied - 1 tbsp of fish sauce - 2 tbsp of cornstarch slurry INSTRUCTIONS:  - blanch meat by placing it in a pot of boiling water along with ginger and vinegar for 10-15 mins. Rinse off any impurities. - Place in pressure cooker setting aside the balls to cook for another 35-45 minutes or until tender along with more aromatics. This will serve as the broth for our soup.  - Remove the meat, slice into bite sized chunks and set aside - Saute onions, garlic, leeks and ginger in annatto oil until soft before adding back your meat. Add in your chilies, sibot, sugar, salt, and radishes, and lemongrass. - Fill the pot with reserved broth and simmer for 30 minutes, add fish sauce/salt/pepper and cornstarch slurry. Mix well until thickened. - Serve and enjoy! #Soups #ASMR #filipinofood

d: Homemade in n out burgers 🍔 ✨  Can you believe I’ve filmed this exact thing 6 times and I finally liked how it turned out 😭 Full recipe below ⬇️  Ingredients  Burgers - 1.5 pounds ground beef (80/20) - iceberg lettuce - tomatoes, sliced  - american cheese or sharp cheddar, slices  - brioche buns - Salt and pepper to taste caramelized onions - 2 large white onions, diced - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 2 tbsp butter - 1 tsp granulated sugar - 1/2 tsp salt sauce  - 1 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup ketchup  - 1/4 cup caramelized onions  - 2 tbsp pickles, finely chopped  - 1 tbsp yellow mustard  - 1 tsp distilled white vinegar  - 1 tsp sugar - 1/2 tsp salt  - 1/4 tsp black pepper  Instructions: - In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, mustard, ketchup, onions, pickles, salt, pepper, sugar, and vinegar together.  Cover and refrigerate while you prepare the rest. - Heat a small pan over low heat with 1 tbsp oil and butter. Cook onions slowly for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden brown, and sweet. Set aside. Burgers  - Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions (about 100g each) - Roll each into a ball, then flatten into thin patties about 1/4-inch thick. (Wider than the bun – they'll shrink.) - Season one side generously with salt and pepper. Keep chilled until ready to cook. Buns  - Cut the buns in half - Lightly butter the cut sides. - Toast them cut-side down in a dry skillet or griddle over medium heat until golden and crispy. Remove and set aside. Cook the Burger Patties - Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Smothered Hamburger Steak & Onion Gravy 🤎  If you’ve got ground beef and you’re tired of making the same thing, try this! These homemade hamburger steaks are smothered in a rich onion gravy and are the definition of comfort food. Ingredients: Hamburger Steaks * 2 lbs ground beef * 1 egg * ½ cup breadcrumbs * 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp seasoning salt * ½ tsp black pepper Onion Gravy * 1 large onion, sliced * 2 tbsp butter * 2 tbsp flour * 2½ cups beef broth * 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * Black pepper, to taste Instructions: 1. Mix the ground beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire sauce, and seasonings. 2. Form into 5–6 oval patties. 3. Brown the patties in a hot skillet for about 4–5 minutes per side, then remove and set aside. 4. Add butter and sliced onions to the same skillet and cook until soft and golden. 5. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for about 1 minute. 6. Slowly pour in the beef broth while stirring. 7. Add Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and black pepper. 8. Let the gravy simmer until it begins to thicken. 9. Add the hamburger steaks back to the skillet and spoon the gravy over them. 10. Cover and simmer for 10–15 minutes, or until the meat is fully cooked and the gravy is thick. Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite vegetable on the side. 🤤 Save this one for your next comfort-food dinner! #HamburgerSteak #GroundBeefRecipes #ComfortFood #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipes

These cabbage dumplings make that part a whole lot easier. 🥟🥟🔥 Cabbage Dumplings Ingredients Ground chicken, 2 pounds Portabella mushrooms, finely diced, 8 ounces Scallions, finely sliced, 4 Soy sauce, 2 tablespoons Oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon Chicken bouillon powder, 1 teaspoon Salt and black pepper, to taste Small Napa cabbage, 1 to 2 heads Furikake, for garnish Chili oil, for serving Sliced scallions, for garnish Instructions Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Blanch the Napa cabbage leaves for 45 seconds to 1 minute, just until softened and flexible. Transfer to a towel and pat dry. In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, mushrooms, scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken bouillon, salt, and pepper. Mix until everything is well combined. Spoon the filling onto the base of each cabbage leaf. Fold in the sides and roll tightly to seal. Arrange the dumplings seam side down in a large skillet or steamer. Add 1/4 cup water to the pan, cover, and steam over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees. Remove the lid and let any remaining water evaporate for 1 to 2 minutes. Finish with furikake, a drizzle of chili oil, and sliced scallions before serving. #dumplings #cabbage #healthyeating #food #foodtiktok

“Nagger” is a viral brainrot catchphrase that exploded across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social media platforms in 2026. The meme is based on a short CGI animation featuring a silver humanoid robot that slowly turns its head toward the camera before staring directly at the viewer with a completely emotionless expression. After an awkward pause, the robot quietly says, “Nagger.” In the context of the meme, the word is intended to mean someone who nags or constantly annoys others, and the strange delivery is what made the clip so memorable. Although the original animation had existed online before its rise in popularity, it remained relatively obscure until brainrot creators rediscovered it and began editing it into absurd videos. By early 2026, heavily edited versions of the clip—featuring distorted audio, exaggerated bass boosts, dramatic zoom-ins, glowing eyes, random sound effects, and intentionally low video quality—started circulating widely. One of the earliest edits quickly gained millions of views and inspired thousands of remixes, reaction videos, and parodies across multiple platforms. The meme rapidly evolved beyond the original animation. Creators inserted the robot into unrelated videos, interrupted emotional moments with the sudden appearance of “Nagger,” and combined it with other viral brainrot memes. Many edits included subway surfers gameplay, Family Guy clips, Minecraft parkour, vine booms, reverb effects, and increasingly chaotic visual distortions. Some versions repeated the word dozens of times, while others slowed the robot’s head turn to build suspense before the single-word punchline. Part of the meme’s appeal comes from its complete lack of explanation. The robot never smiles, changes expression, or provides any context for why it says the word. Instead, the humor comes from the awkward silence, the eerie stare, and the unexpected seriousness of the delivery. Like many modern brainrot memes, the joke is less about the word itself and more about the absurd editing, repetition, and the internet’s tendency to treat a completely random moment as if it carries deep meaning.  #iwanttogoviral #blowthisup #xyzbca #fyp #sheldoncooper

The wide furry paws, the thick coat, the big size, all of it comes from generations of cats living out in the cold and the snow. Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta 🍝 Ingredients 1 chicken breast (cut in half) ½ tbsp paprika ½ tbsp garlic powder ½ tbsp onion powder 1 tsp salt 1 tsp black pepper Dash of olive oil 3 cups cooked pasta 2 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp butter 1 small onion, diced 3 garlic cloves, minced 1½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 1 tbsp tomato paste ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes 1 tbsp Italian seasoning 1 tbsp paprika Salt and pepper to taste ¾ cup heavy cream ½ cup pasta water 2 cups spinach (or less if preferred) 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese Instructions: - Season chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. - Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook on both sides until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from the pan and set aside. - In the same pan, add butter and diced onion. Cook until onions are translucent, then add minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute. - Stir in cherry tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes, stirring for another minute. - Add Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute, then pour in the heavy cream and pasta water. Stir well and let it simmer for 2 minutes. - Add spinach and Parmesan cheese. Stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy. - Slice the cooked chicken and return it to the pan. Let it simmer briefly to absorb the flavors, then add the cooked pasta. Toss until everything is evenly coated. - Garnish with extra Parmesan and serve warm and enjoy! #pasta #chicken  #ho#homemadefoodunch #dinner

Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor. Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Steak Bites Ingredients 1. 1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut into bite-sized cubes 2. 1 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp salt 6. 1 tsp black pepper 7. 1 tsp paprika 8. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 9. 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 10. 1/2 cup beef broth 11. 1/2 cup heavy cream 12. 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 13. 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 14. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 15. 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 16. 2 tbsp fresh chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pat the steak cubes dry with paper towels so they brown properly. 2. Season the steak with salt, black pepper, paprika, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Add the steak bites in a single layer without overcrowding the pan. 5. Sear for 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned and cooked to your preferred doneness. 6. Transfer the steak bites to a plate and keep them warm. 7. Reduce the heat to medium and add the butter to the same skillet. 8. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 4–6 minutes until golden and tender. 9. Add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes, then sauté for about 30 seconds. 10. Pour in the beef broth and Worcestershire sauce, scraping the browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. 11. Stir in the heavy cream and bring the sauce to a gentle simmer. 12. Add the Parmesan cheese and stir until completely melted and the sauce becomes creamy. 13. Return the seared steak bites and their juices to the skillet. 14. Toss the steak bites through the creamy sauce and simmer for 2–3 minutes so they absorb the flavors. 15. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. 16. Garnish generously with fresh chopped parsley and serve immediately with mashed potatoes, rice, or crusty bread. Creamy garlic parmesan chicken meatballs ✨ Ingredients  Meatballs  - 1.5lbs - 2lbs ground chicken - 1 large egg  - 1/3 cup panko bread crumbs  - 1/4 cup parmesan cheese - 2 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 tbsp heavy cream - 2 tsp garlic paste - 2 tsp smoked paprika  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 2 tsp complete seasoning  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Fire & Smoke Society garlic & herb seasoning  - Salt and pepper to taste Garlic parmesan sauce - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 2 cups baby spinach - 1/4 cup unsalted butter (4 tbsp) - 6 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste Instruction  - Add the ground chicken to a large bowl with the egg, panko, Parmesan, parsley, heavy cream, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, complete seasoning, oregano, garlic & herb seasoning, salt, and pepper. - Mix until just combined, then form into evenly sized meatballs. - Place the meatballs on a parchment-lined tray and freeze for 30–45 minutes. This helps them firm up and hold their shape while cooking. - Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sear the meatballs on all sides until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and set aside. - In the same skillet, melt the butter. Add the minced shallot and sauté for 1–2 minutes, then add the garlic and cook until fragrant. - Pour in the heavy cream and season with oregano, garlic powder, red chili flakes, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to a gentle simmer. - Add the Parmesan and stir until melted and the sauce is creamy and smooth. - Add the spinach and cook until wilted. - Return the chicken meatballs to the skillet and coat them in the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce. - Let everything simmer together for a few minutes, then finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan. If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. Twix Caramel Crunch Ice Cream Cone #shorts #food #recipe FULL RECIPE 👇🏿  TWIX CARAMEL CRUNCH ICE CREAM CONES Makes 4–6 cones Ingredients 16 ounces milk chocolate or milk chocolate melting wafers 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream 1 can (14 ounces) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup caramel sauce 6–8 fun-size Twix bars, chopped Extra caramel sauce for the centers Instructions 1.Place large piping bags inside tall cups, folding the tops over the rims to hold them open. 2.Melt the milk chocolate until smooth. Spoon chocolate into each piping bag and rotate the bag to coat the inside completely. 3.Pour out any excess chocolate, then place the coated bags in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add a second chocolate layer and freeze again until firm. 4.In a chilled bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form. 5.Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk and ½ cup caramel sauce until combined. 6.Fold in the chopped Twix bars, reserving a small amount for garnish if desired. 7.Spoon or pipe the Twix ice cream mixture halfway into each chocolate cone. 8.Add a generous line or spoonful of caramel down the center. Fill the cones with the remaining ice cream mixture, keeping the caramel enclosed inside because apparently regular caramel wasn’t dramatic enough. 9.Tap the cones gently to remove air pockets. Twist and secure the piping bags. 10.Freeze overnight, or until completely firm. Carefully cut and peel away the piping bags. Finish with caramel drizzle and chopped Twix before serving.
